paramRecords.value: Clearing the rubble requires level 2 Mining. Find a way to attain this; Roddeck may have some useful advice.
Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
It seems that smashing through solid rock is a harder job than it looked. You'll need to get in some practice in order to be up to the task.
On the ground nearby is a spot where stone has fallen from the ceiling. Click on it, or use your pick on it, to hack at it and practice the art of mining.
Each lump of rock you successfully shatter will yield some chippings and 42 experience. The chippings are useless to you and can be safely dropped on the floor using their right-click option.
Gaining 83 experience from breaking the stone will allow you to reach level 2 and be ready to deal with the major rubble blockage.
